source_user_statement: User unpacked their Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11 client JAR and uploaded extracted contents under this repository's 1.21.11 directory.
technical_note: A directory extracted from a JAR is not the same byte sequence as the ZIP/JAR container. Independently hashing extracted PNGs and JSON files does not authenticate full original client.jar SHA-1 or its official Mojang origin.
